statements.status_notes: Neo4j Maven jackson.version property bumps standalone jackson-core artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. CVE-2026-89407 is triggered when jackson-databind coerces attacker-supplied string tokens to numbers via NumberInput.looksLikeValidNumber(); parquet-jackson deserializes only its own fixed-schema footer metadata POJOs from on-disk Parquet files and does not run that coercion on untrusted HTTP JSON payloads, so the ReDoS path is not reachable through Neo4j's usage.

Neo4j Maven jackson.version property bumps standalone jackson-core artifacts to 2.22.3. The only remaining 2.22.2 copy is shaded inside parquet-jackson 1.18.1, which has no newer parquet release. CVE-2026-89425 is reachable only through JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput) on attacker-controlled input; parquet-jackson reads Parquet footers with stream-based parsers and does not expose a DataInput parser surface on Neo4j's Parquet import path, so the unbounded invalid-token accumulation path is not reachable.

This PURL is not a real, resolvable Maven dependency of this build. The module-local com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core dependency is pinned to 2.21.7 (bumped from 2.21.6, which was itself in this CVE's affected range of 2.19.0-2.21.6 - see mvn-dependencies.json). The separate 2.22.2 PURL this VEX statement covers comes from org.apache.parquet:parquet-jackson 1.18.1 (the latest published release), which relocates its entire internal Jackson copy under shaded.parquet.com.fasterxml.jackson.* but leaves non-relocated META-INF/maven/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core/pom.properties metadata behind. Verified by downloading parquet-jackson-1.18.1.jar from Maven Central and inspecting it directly: it contains zero unshaded com/fasterxml/jackson/*.class files (all 1102 Jackson classes are under shaded/parquet/com/fasterxml/jackson/*), so no code is actually loadable at the com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core coordinate SBOM tooling attributes this version to.

CVE-2026-89407 is fixed in jackson-core 2.21.7 / tools.jackson 3.1.7 on the classpath copy this image forces. The remaining 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs are shaded inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Call sites inside that jar for this CVE are still under investigation.

CVE-2026-68494 is the same bug as GHSA-r7wm-3cxj-wff9 on these shaded jackson-core 2.21.2 and tools.jackson 3.1.2 PURLs. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated async-parser package or the createNonBlockingByteArrayParser, createNonBlockingParser, or NonBlockingJsonParser symbols. The vulnerable shaded code therefore has no execution path in this image.

CVE-2026-18401 affects Jackson's non-blocking JSON parser in jackson-core 2.18.1 and 2.19.2, which are shaded inside parquet-jackson (parquet 1.15.2 on Spark 4.0.x, parquet 1.16.0/1.17.0 on Spark 4.1.x/4.2.x). Spark's managed jackson-core is already at fixed versions (2.18.10 on 4.0.x via fasterxml.jackson.version, 2.21.6 on 4.1.x/4.2.x via mvn-deps). The shaded copies cannot be repinned without an upstream Parquet release that rebuilds parquet-jackson against a fixed jackson-core.

GHSA-r7wm-3cxj-wff9 is a memory-exhaustion flaw in jackson-core's non-blocking parser when an integer token spans input chunks and maxNumberLength validation is not applied. The staged 1.6.0.1 image uses fixed jackson-core 2.21.5 on the application classpath; Scout identifies the affected 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 PURLs only inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar. Bytecode scans found no DataHub application class or non-Jackson Hazelcast class referencing either relocated async-parser package or the createNonBlockingByteArrayParser, createNonBlockingParser, or NonBlockingJsonParser symbols. The vulnerable shaded code therefore has no execution path in this image.

The built image SBOM locates jackson-core 2.21.2 and 3.1.2 inside hazelcast-5.7.0.jar in nifi-hazelcast-services-nar, and jackson-core 2.21.3 inside parquet-jackson-1.17.1.jar in nifi-iceberg-parquet-writer-nar. NiFi's Maven dependency management cannot directly replace these embedded copies. Remediation requires upgrading the enclosing artifacts: Parquet 1.18.0 embeds jackson-core 2.22.1 but requires compatibility validation, while Hazelcast currently has no newer release that embeds fixed jackson-core 2.x and 3.x versions.
